proof_dependency_chain: Derive constants and paired finite observations from naturality.
Use Boolean complement and intersection to construct an actual ultrafilter.
Recover every finite observation from its unique ultrafilter-large fibre and prove the two constructions inverse.
Define pushforward, point records and flattening by observation evaluation.
Prove all functor and monad laws on actual record values and identify the operations with ultrafilter pushforward, pure and join.
Prove finite-test transport agrees on the original universe and is uniquely forced by maps to finite skeletal tests.
Combine point injectivity, finite principal-ultrafilter classification and an actual cofinite-extending ultrafilter to characterize point surjectivity.
temptations: Extend a Yoneda-style point-recovery argument from all sets to only finite tests.
Assume finite observations already distinguish genuine points from all coherent records.
Stop at a natural bijection and omit the nested-record multiplication.
new_mathematical_content: The core is a new finite-observation codensity classification and monad calculation, not MG-R009 descent or MG-R010 probe-space exponentials. It has a known named theorem, so familiarity may give a short valid solution.
related_case_correlation: Mathematically related to MG-R019 through ultrafilters. Inputs and outputs are different and neither candidate task references the other, but their scores must not be treated as independent dimensions.
